filter_query_by_read_permission: filter a SQLAlchemy query to return only documents where the user has read permission via groups or ownership
filter_query_by_write_permission: filter a SQLAlchemy query to return only documents where the user has write permission via groups or ownership
filter_query_by_read_only_permission: filter a SQLAlchemy query to return only documents where the user has read but not write permission, excluding public items
apply_access_control_to_query: apply access control filtering to a SQLAlchemy query using user_id and group_ids for permission checks
build_permission_query_with_db_dialect: build a permission-filtered query that handles both SQLite and PostgreSQL dialects for JSON/JSONB access control fields
